terms.definition: The force per unit mass on a small mass placed in the field, g = F/m.
terms.examiner: Unit N kg⁻¹. 'Small' (test) mass so it does not change the field.

terms.definition: The work done per unit mass in moving a small mass from infinity to that point.
terms.examiner: Always negative; zero at infinity. V = −GM/r.

terms.definition: A surface on which every point has the same gravitational potential.
terms.examiner: No work is done moving along it; it is perpendicular to the field lines.
